text: In simplicial type theory, a covariant family (fibration) F:A→U over a Segal type A satisfies:
choices: for each morphism f:hom_A(a,b), there is a covariant action F(f):F(a)→F(b)
explanation: A covariant family has a covariant transport: morphisms f:hom(a,b) act covariantly by F(f):F(a)→F(b). This is the functoriality of F as an ∞-functor A→U.
